title: Generate Text > OpenAI > Web Search > Zod validation error if the web sources include `oai-<sports|finance|etc.>` sources

linked_prs.title: fix(openai): add support for sources type 'api'
linked_prs.body:
## Background

We get Zod validation errors if the web sources include `oai-<sports|finance|etc>` sources.

See #9978 

## Summary

- Updated the openai responses schema to allow for source type `api` to be accepted. 
- Updated the web search output schema to allow the source type `api` to be exposed.

## Manual Verification

- Added unit tests
- E2E UI tests for this are hard to recreate since the model may or may not return that particular source.

## Checklist

- [x] Tests have been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)
- [ ] Documentation has been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)
- [x] A _patch_ changeset for relevant packages has been added (for bug fixes / features - run `pnpm changeset` in the project root)

## Future Work

look into adding fallbacks for all response schemas so that the Zod validation errors don't occur (once provider response schemas change)

## Related Issues

Fixes #9978
